source_claim: KONAMI's official pop'n music product topics identify MZD as a pop'n music character. KONAMI's official SOUND VOLTEX anniversary announcement identifies レイシス (Rasis) as a character of SOUND VOLTEX. These exact game-specific first-party sources support separate direct HOME relations for MZD and Rasis; no BEMANI umbrella HOME is inferred for the campaign.
notes: The pop'n music Jam&Fizz official topics index (https://www.konami.com/arcadegames/topics/list/?game=am_popn_jamfizz&type=topics) has an official pop'n birthday topic naming MZD. KONAMI's official SOUND VOLTEX 12th anniversary notice (https://www.konami.com/videonews/movie_view.html?movie_url=6345788920112) explicitly calls レイシス a SOUND VOLTEX character. The campaign candidate `bemani` is an umbrella spanning separately titled music games and is not proposed as a HOME. No relations are proposed for `kougei_ciel_nana`, `maud`, `rie-chan`, or `sanae-chan`: the checked first-party routes did not establish an exact canonical game/work HOME for these members; secondary databases/community pages were not promoted into authority. This batch is positive partial progress, not a terminal review of the four unassigned members.
